entities.summary: Antigoni Papadopoulou is a Greek Cypriot politician and chemist. She was one of the first two Cypriot women to be elected as Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) among six Cypriot MEPs (2009). She is a former Member of the House of Representatives of the Republic of Cyprus and the First Woman to serve as Chair of the House's Committee of Economic Affairs and Budgeting (2006–2009). She was an Assembly Member of the Council of Europe from 2001 to 2009 and has also served as Vice Chairperson of the Committee of Economic Affairs of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (2003–2009).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As one of the first two Cypriot women elected to the European Parliament, Antigoni Papadopoulou played a significant role in promoting gender equality and empowering women's representation in politics. Her tenure as Chair of the House's Committee of Economic Affairs and Budgeting from 2006-2009 also highlighted her expertise in economic policy.
